title: Fourier Dimension in Inhomogeneous Duffin--Schaeffer Conjecture
summary: Let \(Q \subseteq \mathbb{N}\) be a subset, and let \(ψ\colon \mathbb{N} \to [0, \tfrac{1}{2})\), \(θ\colon \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}\) be functions. Let \(\{A_q\}\) and \(\{B_q\}\) be sequences of integers such that \(\gcd(A_q, B_q) = 1\) and \(B_q > 0\) for all \(q\). Define \(W_Q^{\ast}(ψ,θ)\) to be the set of \(x \in [0,1]\) for which \[ \left| x - \frac{p + θ(q)}{q} \right| < \frac{ψ(q)}{q} \] holds for infinitely many \((p,q) \in \mathbb{Z} \times Q\) with \(\gcd(B_q p + A_q, q) = 1\).
